name: PLD (Pegylated Liposomal DOXOrubicin)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT single-agent option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: PLD is low-to-moderate emetogenic; give per emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: Palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia (hand-foot syndrome) and stomatitis are the dose-limiting toxicities: counsel on skin care, avoid heat/pressure, and dose-delay or reduce for grade 2-3.
Liposomal formulation reduces but does not eliminate anthracycline cardiotoxicity; track cumulative anthracycline exposure.
monitoring: skin and oral-mucosa assessment each cycle
cumulative anthracycline dose and LVEF if clinically indicated

drugs.name: Pegylated Liposomal DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: PLD 40 mg/m2 IV on day 1 every 28 days, continued to response/progression or unacceptable toxicity. A common single agent for platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian cancer; may be combined with bevacizumab. Reduce/delay for hand-foot syndrome or mucositis per package insert. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
